name: agent-skiller
description: Lightweight node editor that outputs reusable Markdown skills for AI agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-skiller/core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agent-skiller/core && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agent-skiller/core && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build:static: npm run build -w @agent-skiller/core && npm run build -w web
